channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: US closely monitoring case of lab worker who possibly died of plague in Siberia
item.description: Quarantine measures in place in several hospitals in eastern Russia amid uncertainty over death of Darya Shipilova (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: OpenTelemetry Makes Kubernetes Attributes Processor Stable as Observability Schema Matures
item.description: OpenTelemetry has promoted its Kubernetes Attributes Processor to v1.0.0, marking a significant step in making Kubernetes telemetry more predictable and stable across observability pipelines. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Perseus: A Fail-Slow Detection Framework for Cloud Storage Systems (2023)
item.description: Abstract: The newly-emerging “fail-slow” failures plague both software and hardware where the victim components are still functioning yet with degraded performance. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap
item.description: Memory is often the first hard limit a Kubernetes cluster hits. Nodes run out of RAM long before they run out of CPU, and the new wave of agentic AI workloads makes this worse. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Try WarpBuild free
item.description: More AI code means more commits and more CI. Run GitHub Actions 2x faster at half the cost with a one-line change. Redeem code START50 for $50 in free credits. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Can Claude fix itself? From no to maybe
item.description: An Anthropic engineer's answer shifted from no to maybe in six months. Three incidents show what Claude can investigate, fix, and still get wrong. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: The Register’s summary of a previous talk
item.description: QCon London: It's still a job for humans, even though bots can search logs at the speed of I/O (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: SLA Calculator: Uptime & Downtime Budget
item.description: Calculate allowed downtime for 99%, 99.9%, 99.95%, 99.99% and 99.999% uptime. Compare daily to yearly budgets and check downtime used. No signup. (1 source: sreweekly)
